meta.title: Medical Device Registration Checklist: Four Markets
meta.assumption: Assumption: general medical devices from a foreign manufacturer, not IVDs. A China Class III device must be reclassified in each market.
meta.disclaimer: Working draft, not the final submission checklist for any product. Generated 2026-11-01 (local machine date). The official websites could not be accessed to retain reviewable text; current requirements must be re-verified.
meta.pending: To be completed: product name/model, intended use, implantable/sterile/IVD status, manufacturer location, existing CE/ISO 13485/NMPA certificates and planned launch date.
meta.no_fees: No fixed fees or timelines are pre-filled. Final classification, clinical requirements, local representative, language and special certifications must be confirmed for the specific product under the regulations in force at the time of submission.
meta.progress_note: Applicability and progress are tracked separately. Until product classification and the documentation gap assessment are complete, task status must not be read as submission-ready.
meta.sources_note: These are official portals and regulation identifiers, not retained evidence of the latest text of each requirement. Reviewable text could not be obtained during this visit; re-verify before acting.

SA.name: Saudi Arabia
SA.local_entity: Saudi Authorized Representative and applicable licensed establishments
SA.key_documents: Technical documentation, QMS, performance/clinical evidence, labeling and authorization letters
SA.premarket_checks: Authorization scope, local licenses, language and Saudi-DI

BR.name: Brazil
BR.classification: ANVISA Class III/IV usually requires registro
BR.pathway: Brazilian registration holder applies to ANVISA for registration
BR.local_entity: Registration holder, importer and AFE/local licenses
BR.key_documents: Technical dossier, GMP/CBPF, Portuguese documentation; INMETRO where applicable to the product
BR.premarket_checks: Product grouping, sites, registration scope and special certifications

DE.name: Germany
DE.classification: Reclassify under EU MDR Annex VIII
DE.pathway: MDR conformity assessment and CE marking; no separate German registration certificate is assumed
DE.local_entity: EU AR, PRRC, importer and other economic operators
DE.key_documents: NB, technical documentation, clinical evidence, DoC, UDI and German-language documentation
DE.premarket_checks: Current EUDAMED modules/deadlines, MPDG and German national obligations

TR.name: Türkiye
TR.classification: Classify under current Turkish medical device regulations
TR.pathway: Conformity/CE evidence plus ÜTS company and product registration
TR.local_entity: Turkish AR, importer and ÜTS-registered entity
TR.key_documents: Certificates, DoC, technical documentation, Turkish labeling/IFU and authorization letters
TR.premarket_checks: Certificate acceptance conditions, ÜTS status, traceability and operating requirements

1.task: Freeze product name, models, intended use, indications, patient population, use environment and mechanism of action
1.note: Input for classification and clinical strategy in all four markets

2.task: Confirm whether the device is an IVD, implantable, sterile, active, software, a combination product or contains special materials
2.note: This checklist assumes a general non-IVD medical device; IVDs follow separate regulations

3.task: Prepare classification rules, rationale and product grouping documents for each of the four markets
3.note: China Class III does not automatically equal Class III or the highest risk class in other markets

4.task: Check manufacturer, sites, outsourced processes and QMS certificate scope/validity
4.note: ISO 13485 does not automatically grant market access in any market

5.task: Prepare device description, design and manufacturing information, safety and performance data and list of applicable standards
5.note: Standard recognition and versions must be checked market by market

6.task: Prepare risk management plan, report and benefit-risk conclusion
6.note: Cover the full lifecycle, usability and residual risks

7.task: Check applicable reports such as performance, electrical safety/EMC and biocompatibility
7.note: Keep only tests relevant to the device's characteristics

8.task: Check sterilization, packaging and transport, shelf life and software/cybersecurity evidence
8.note: Determine applicability by device and market

9.task: Define the clinical evaluation/investigation strategy and an evidence gap table
9.note: Do not assume literature or equivalence can always replace clinical investigations for high-risk devices

10.task: Prepare a per-market list of labeling/IFU, translations, symbols and markings
10.note: Check language exemptions and notarization/legalization requirements document by document

11.task: Set up a responsibility matrix for complaints, vigilance, recalls, changes and renewals
11.note: Timelines, channels and intervals follow current local regulations

12.task: Confirm SFDA classification and MDMA application route
12.note: China Class III does not automatically equal Class D

13.task: Appoint a Saudi Authorized Representative and check its license, responsibilities and term
13.note: Follow the requirements for foreign manufacturers

14.task: Prepare manufacturer/site, QMS, authorization and account documents
14.note: Check the current platform, formats and entity qualifications

15.task: Prepare MDMA forms, technical documentation, risk, performance and clinical data
15.note: Run a gap assessment against current MDS-REQ1 and the applicable route

16.task: Check Arabic/English labeling, IFU and Saudi-DI requirements
16.note: Confirm by user type, device class and current implementation status

17.task: Confirm fees, submission and deficiency responses, authorization scope and import/distribution licenses
17.note: Manage MDMA, establishment licenses and post-market obligations separately

18.task: Confirm class, product grouping and route under RDC 751/2022 and its amendments
18.note: Class III/IV general medical devices usually follow registro; check IVDs separately

19.task: Designate the Brazilian registration holder and check AFE and local operating licenses
19.note: Clarify registration ownership, distribution relationships and access to documents

20.task: Check GMP/CBPF requirements for manufacturing sites and acceptable evidence
20.note: Verify acceptance conditions for certificates, pending applications or other routes

21.task: Determine whether INMETRO or other local conformity certification applies
21.note: Not all devices require this certification

22.task: Prepare registration forms, technical dossier, performance/clinical evidence and declarations
22.note: Prepare according to the current document list and the specific product

23.task: Complete Portuguese labeling/IFU and check translation and certification of documents
23.note: Do not list notarization/legalization as required for all documents by default

24.task: Confirm fees, submission and deficiency responses, registration scope and change/post-market requirements
24.note: Registration does not replace import and operating licenses

25.task: Classify under MDR Annex VIII and determine the conformity assessment route
25.note: Do not carry over the China Class III conclusion directly

26.task: Confirm the responsibilities of the EU Authorized Representative, PRRC, importer and distributors

27.task: Select an NB whose designation scope covers the device and start the assessment
27.note: MDR Class III usually requires NB involvement; check the scope in NANDO

28.task: Complete Annex II/III documentation, GSPR checklist, QMS and verification evidence
28.note: Organize according to the selected assessment procedure

29.task: Confirm applicability of clinical investigations, PMCF, SSCP and implant card
29.note: Additional requirements and exemptions for Class III/implantable devices need product-level assessment

30.task: Check the NB certificate, EU DoC, CE marking and German labeling/IFU
30.note: Assess the new MDR route and the legacy-directive transition route separately

31.task: Check SRN, UDI, mandatory EUDAMED modules and transition periods for devices already on the market
31.note: EUDAMED module status in 2026 is time-sensitive; recheck the latest European Commission notices

32.task: Check MPDG, competent state authority and notification obligations by location and role
32.note: General CE market access does not require a separate German product registration certificate

33.task: Implement PMS, PSUR, PMCF, vigilance and certificate surveillance
33.note: Check intervals and reporting recipients against the actual class and current rules

34.task: Confirm current Turkish classification, conformity route and transitional provisions
34.note: Do not treat China Class III or an EU certificate as the local classification outcome

35.task: Confirm the Turkish Authorized Representative, importer and the entity operating in ÜTS
35.note: Check by manufacturer location and economic operator role

36.task: Check CE certificate, DoC, NB scope and local acceptance conditions
36.note: CE marking does not mean all Turkish local formalities are complete

37.task: Complete the required ÜTS company records and verification of authorization documents
37.note: Translation/notarization, document format and system roles must be confirmed against current rules

38.task: Create ÜTS product records and link certificates/declarations
38.note: Check consistency of company, product and certificate data

39.task: Check Turkish labeling/IFU, UDI and local markings
39.note: Language exemptions and traceability requirements depend on the product

40.task: Maintain ÜTS traceability, vigilance, recalls and record changes
40.note: Define the ongoing responsibilities of the manufacturer, AR and importer

SA1.topic: Check current MDS-REQ1, classification, AR, Saudi-DI and vigilance guidance

BR1.topic: Check RDC 751/2022 and amendments, GMP/CBPF requirements

BR2.topic: Registration services, AFE, INMETRO applicability and post-market matters

DE1.topic: Consolidated text, amendments, transitional provisions and annexes

DE2.topic: NB designation scope, NANDO and implementation guidance

DE3.topic: Check mandatory application dates of modules and transition periods for each actor and for legacy devices

TR1.topic: Check the current Tıbbi Cihaz Yönetmeliği (Medical Device Regulation) and announcements

TR2.topic: Check company/product registration, document formats and traceability requirements
